summary:
Comprehensive Staff Engineering Architecture Specification for extending the Git Manager Pro 8-Point Spatial System across the entire application:
- Unifies design tokens, canvas (#0B0F19), surfaces (#131B2E, #1C263E, #263454), borders (#212E4A, #31446E), and Git semantic colors (add #3FB950, del #F85149, mod #388BFD, branch #58A6FF, merge #A371F7, warn #D29922) across both Desktop and Mobile.
- Standardizes typography on Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono with strict tabular figures.
- Propagates the 8-point spatial foundation (4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 20px, 24px, 32px, 40px, 44px, 48px, 56px) across DesktopLayout, MobileShell, CommitDetailModal, and Repositories.
- Implements the complete verified commit inspection bottom sheet (lineage tree, quantitative churn bar, interactive hunks, and CI/CD stages).
